name: Star Trek TNG - Sovy i sahar
original_name: Star Trek TNG - Совы и сахар
source:
The Enterprise crew finds themselves in the pioneer camp "Sovenok". But what caused it? And how will they get back to the ship?

You are a Starfleet commander and first mate, William Riker. Together with Captain Picard, the android Data, and the chief of technical services, Miles O'Brien, you must solve the mystery of the pioneer camp. Boldly go where no man has gone before!
